welcome.desc: {{godName}} is your office manager. He runs a small team of AI workers for you, and you watch it all from one screen. Here's what's inside:

home.desc: Create a new, empty folder for the app to call home. Everything the app remembers (its own settings and your agents' memory) is stored here. Something like ~/HarnessAgents works well. We'll create it for you if it doesn't exist.
home.note: You won't need to open this folder day to day. It's just where the app keeps its notes, so nothing is lost when you restart.
home.syncWarningTitle: DON'T PUT THIS IN A SYNCED FOLDER
home.syncWarning: Keep it out of Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive and iCloud Drive, and out of Desktop or Documents if your computer backs those up to the cloud. The app writes here constantly, and syncing can corrupt your team's memory and break the link the app uses to keep them in check. The suggested ~/HarnessAgents is safe.

orchestrator.desc: {{godName}} is your office manager. He reads your requests, breaks them into tasks, and hands them to the right team member. He runs the floor; you own the business. He runs on Claude Code. Pick which Claude model he uses.
orchestrator.cliAgent: Claude Code, made by Anthropic, is the AI that powers your office. It runs right here on this Mac. Your manager is always on and runs your whole office. We recommend Opus 5.5, the newest model.
orchestrator.workersOnlyHint: Can't drain hive mail yet, so it can't run your office. Still available when hiring workers.
orchestrator.modelNote: This sets the model {{godName}} uses. You can change it later.
orchestrator.maxPlan: You'll need a Claude Max plan to keep your office running full time. Smaller plans reach their usage limit during the day, and the office pauses until the limit resets.

permissions.autonomyHead: HOW MUCH CAN AGENTS DO ON THEIR OWN?
permissions.autoLabel: LET AGENTS WORK ON THEIR OWN
permissions.autoOn: On. Agents carry out tasks without stopping to ask, for the smoothest experience.
permissions.autoOff: Off. Agents pause and ask you before changing files or running commands.
permissions.autoNote: Best when agents work in their own projects. You can change this later, including for individual agents.
permissions.reliabilityHead: KEEP THINGS RUNNING WHILE YOU'RE AWAY
permissions.reliabilityDesc: Your agents keep working on a schedule and in live terminals, even when you step away. These settings keep you in the loop and keep things running.
permissions.keepAwakeDesc: Stops your computer from sleeping while an agent is live, so schedules and terminals fire on time even when you step away. Uses more battery, so it's best on power. Off by default.
permissions.notificationsDesc: {{godName}} pings you when something needs you, even while you're away. Your system may ask permission the first time.
permissions.openAtLoginDesc: Relaunch the harness after a reboot so scheduled missions resume on their own. No prompt; applies immediately.
permissions.shareStatsDesc: A handful of anonymous events (app opened, agent spawned, feature used) that help improve the app. Never prompts, code, file paths, or agent output. Full list in TELEMETRY.md; change anytime in Settings.
permissions.stayAwakeDescMac: macOS only lets you set this one yourself. In Battery → Options, turn on "Prevent automatic sleeping when the display is off" (on power adapter) so timers keep firing with the display asleep. Without a setting that prevents sleep, the Mac still truly sleeps; work survives and catches up on wake.
permissions.stayAwakeDescWindows: Windows only lets you set this one yourself. In Settings → System → Power & battery → Screen, blank & sleep, set "On battery power, put my device to sleep" and "When plugged in" to Never (or increase them) so timers keep firing. Without a setting that prevents sleep, Windows still truly sleeps; work survives and catches up on wake.
permissions.stayAwakeDescLinux: Your desktop environment only lets you set this one yourself. Look for a Power Settings panel (for example GNOME Settings → Power, or KDE System Settings → Power Management) and turn off automatic sleep or suspend while on power. Without a setting that prevents sleep, your machine still truly sleeps; work survives and catches up on wake.

triggerHistory.clearConfirm: Delete all {{count}} messages? The record is gone for good.

fullscreenTerminal.closeAgent: Close {{name}}. Ends the process and archives the agent
fullscreenTerminal.ideTip: Open the IDE: browse and edit files in {{name}}'s workspace, and see their uncommitted changes as a diff.
fullscreenTerminal.openTerminalTip: Open your system terminal app in {{cwd}}: a normal shell in this agent's folder, separate from the agent's own terminal.

memoryPanel.plainNotesStill: Agents still keep plain notes without it.

threads.empty: No conversations yet. Messages this agent receives will appear here as threads.

skillsTab.categoryTitle: Categories as published by the catalog
skillsTab.noSkillsInstalled: No skills installed yet. Open Browse to see what is available.

workersTab.liveIntro: Isolated workers {{godName}} spins up to handle Slack messages. They run to completion, reply in the thread, then shut down.
workersTab.baseBranchTitle: base branch the worktree was cut from
workersTab.preservedIntro: Finished workers whose worktree held work that wasn't merged yet. They're kept (never thrown away automatically) and reclaimed automatically once the work lands in its base branch.

memoryGraph.noMessages: No messages between your team yet. Everyone is shown below.

integrations.errId: Could not derive a valid id from the label.
integrations.errBaseUrlFormat: Base URL must be https:// (or http://127.0.0.1 / localhost for a local target).
integrations.errHeader: Header name must be 1 to 64 characters, using only letters A to Z, digits 0 to 9, or hyphens.
integrations.galleryDesc: Choose what you're connecting. The template sets the defaults. Pick Custom REST for anything not listed.
integrations.label: Label
integrations.secretDesc: Encrypted in the main process and never shown again. To change it, paste a new key; the old one can't be read back.
integrations.blankKeepsKey: Leave blank to keep the saved key.
integrations.addSecretToEnable: Add a secret and enable to make it available.
integrations.disabledNoUse: Disabled. No worker can use it.
integrations.v1Note: v1 grants every enabled integration to all workers. Limiting each one to specific workers is coming.
integrations.testAfterSave: Save the integration first, then test the live connection.
integrations.testLiveDesc: Runs a live, read only probe against the base URL with the stored secret.
integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.titleDesc: Connect outside tools so your agents can read and act on them. Secrets are stored encrypted in the main process and never shown again.
integrations.empty: No integrations yet. Connect GitHub or a custom REST API so your agents can use it.

kanban.newWorkHint: new work? dispatch it to {{godName}} (monitor tab)
kanban.needsYouTitle: waiting on YOUR answer; see the ASK ME tab
kanban.dismissTitle: dismiss this task (removes it from the board)
kanban.awaitingAnswer: AWAITING YOUR ANSWER: ASK ME TAB

queueComposer.heldFloor: held: delivery is paused for the whole floor
queueComposer.heldDraft: held: {{name}}'s terminal has unsent text on its prompt
queueComposer.heldPicker: held: a slash command picker is open in {{name}}'s terminal
queueComposer.sendingOneByOne: sending to {{name}} one at a time…
queueComposer.pausedTitle: Automatic delivery is paused for the whole floor. Resume it in the Command Center, or use "send now" on a message below.
queueComposer.sendNowTitle: Deliver this message even though automatic delivery is paused. It moves to the front of the queue and types in as soon as the terminal is free.
queueComposer.ffNoKeyTitle: Dictation needs a free Groq API key. Click the info mark for the steps.
queueComposer.ffTitle: Free Flow: dictate into the queue. Click, or hold Option (⌥).
queueComposer.ffSetupIntro: Speak instead of typing. Groq transcribes it, and their free tier covers this: no card, no cost.
queueComposer.ffPasteKey: Paste it into Settings → Voice → Groq API key
queueComposer.ffClickOrHold: Click voice, or hold the right Option key to talk
queueComposer.ffHoldHint: Hold it ALONE for a moment to start; release to transcribe into the composer, where you can edit before sending. Either Option key works, and Option+key combos still reach the terminal untouched.

idePanel.workspaceInferred: No agent was named when the IDE opened, so this shows {{name}}'s workspace (the current selection)
idePanel.collapseGit: Collapse the git panel for more room for the file tree
idePanel.binaryDiff: binary file, so there's no text diff

gitPanes.baseTitle: Base: the branch you're comparing against
gitPanes.compareTitle: Compare: the branch whose changes you're viewing
gitPanes.modeThreeTitle: Showing what the compare branch ADDS since the common ancestor, the way a PR does. Click for the literal difference between the two branches.
gitPanes.modeTwoTitle: Showing the literal difference between the two branch states. Click to see what compare adds, the way a PR does.

imagePreview.fitTitle: Scale the image down to fit the pane
imagePreview.oneToOneTitle: Show every pixel at 1:1 (scroll to pan)
imagePreview.viewSourceTitle: Open the SVG markup in the editor
imagePreview.decodeFailed: could not decode this image; the file may be corrupt or misnamed

officeMissing.title: WE CAN'T FIND YOUR OFFICE
officeMissing.body: Your office was kept in this folder, and it is no longer there. It may have been moved, renamed or deleted.
officeMissing.whyItMatters: Your team's memory, tasks and history live in that folder, so finding it brings everyone back just as they were.
officeMissing.findHint: Pick the folder where you moved it.
officeMissing.notAnOffice: That folder doesn't have an office in it. Pick the folder you moved, or start over.
officeMissing.couldNotOpen: Couldn't open that office. Try again, or pick another folder.
officeMissing.recent: OR OPEN ONE YOU USED BEFORE
officeMissing.startOverHint: Makes a new, empty office in the same place.
officeMissing.startOverConfirm: Start over with an empty office? Your team won't have its past memory or history.

floorView.label: What the floor shows
floorView.tasksIntro: Every job the team has, by stage: To do, Doing, Blocked and Done. Each card shows who has it, and a ? means it is waiting on you (answer it on the Ask me tab). Click a card for the details.
floorView.graphIntro: Each box is a team member and each line is the messages between them, coloured by kind: asking, answering, agreeing and so on. Turn on topics to see what each one remembers. Click a person to read their memory on {{godName}}'s panel.

companyProfile.intro: Key facts about your business. Every team member, {{godName}} included, works from them. Short answers only: anything longer goes in Memory & Knowledge.
companyProfile.socialHint: One link per line, up to 5.
companyProfile.hoursPlaceholder: For example: Mon to Fri, 9am to 5pm
companyProfile.knowledgeHead: Everything else goes in Memory & Knowledge
companyProfile.knowledgeBody: Product and price lists, your ideal customers, how you sell, policies, your mission: add them as documents in Settings, Memory & Knowledge. Every team member can search them.
companyProfile.saved: Saved. Your team gets the change with their next message.

missing.ceo: Add the CEO or owner's name.
missing.industry: Say what kind of business this is.

clearedBanner.text: The app gave {{name}} a fresh start {{ago}}, after saving a handoff and its notes. Nothing was lost.

ownerVia.explain: {{name}} takes work from {{godName}}. To ask {{name}} something, tell {{godName}}, or talk to {{name}} 1:1.
ownerVia.stuck: {{name}} is waiting on something in their terminal. Talk 1:1 to answer.
ownerVia.inOneOnOneNote: In 1:1 with {{name}}. {{godName}} sends {{name}} no work until you end it.
